name: King of the Raft
source:
The story is about: Atlantis existed and the faction from our legends loved Earthlings. They departed, forgetting about Earth. A new faction sees our inferior species destroying the planet. They claim Earth as theirs, opening portals to flood the oceans to above 7000'. Zack is jet skiing in Florida when the apocalypse happens. He saves a damsel in distress, discovers freaky sea monsters, and creates a raft city. Zack must save the desperate, improve his base, and use the overlords reward system to bide his time.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1718900/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述：亚特兰蒂斯存在，我们传说中的派系热爱地球人。他们离开了，忘记了地球。一个新派系看到我们的劣等物种正在毁灭地球。他们宣称地球是他们的，打开传送门将海洋淹没到7000英尺以上。当世界末日发生时，扎克正在佛罗里达州玩水上摩托艇。他拯救了一位陷入困境的少女，发现了怪异的海怪，并创建了一座木筏城市。扎克必须拯救绝望的人，改善他的基地，并利用霸主奖励系统来等待时机。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1718900/]Steam[/url]]
